name: BF16 evolving OU round-robin 50M
schedule: Sequential publication; each member sees latest completed peer versions; opponents remain fixed during its stint.
other_initializers: 13 named specialist weights from saved/pokemon/starmie_sweep; old unrestricted master remains archived but is replaced in the new active roster.
checkpointing: Every completed member stint is published and retained; initial/final native weights also retained.
continuation: Weights-only stages; optimizer, rollout/recurrent state, step counter and cosine LR schedule restart each stint.
limitations: Oak results are tuning-panel measurements, not ratings; 384-game estimates are noisy.
671M/64.3% and 1.34B/62.1% do not establish a reliable ranking or a learning plateau.
Previous fixed-pool strength is a hypothesis: no evidence here proves all opponents are solved.
